issues.title: Automatic quality changes can never fire
issues.observed: AdaptiveQuality.sample() assigns this.level = next at src/quality/AdaptiveQuality.ts:28 and returns this.level at line 32, so GridAppV4.tick()'s guard `if (level !== this.quality.level)` at src/v4/preview/GridAppV4.ts:358-359 compares a value with itself and is always false. setQuality() is only ever reached through the QA API.
issues.verifiedBy: source read at both line ranges, this loop
issues.sideEffect: It also makes capture deterministic, because quality cannot flip mid-run. Fixing it will make runtime quality genuinely variable, and every harness assumption about a fixed quality:"high" will need rechecking.

issues.title: The 81 slots are not instanced
issues.observed: InfiniteGlassGridV4 constructs three meshes per slot - glass, shell and media - at src/v4/preview/InfiniteGlassGridV4.ts:89, :92 and :95, with no InstancedMesh in the file. Materials (5) and geometries (2) are shared, which is why the pool counters look small; the measured cost is not. qa-v4/results/round1-grid-preview-gate.json reports drawCalls 1833 at 9x9 with slots 81.
issues.verifiedBy: source read plus the tracked gate artifact, this loop
issues.relatedTo: V4-R1-002, which inferred the same thing from the counter rather than from source
